user_reported_bug: User's PROD app shows a gap in the July 2026 invoice sequence. Invoices visible: INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0002 through 0008 plus PI/MDDRC/2026/07/0001 (converted proforma), but INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0001 is missing. User didn't void any invoice. Investigation revealed the DELETE invoice endpoint was hard-deleting invoices (`db.invoices.delete_one`), leaving untraceable audit gaps. Only January 2026 numbers appear in the deleted_invoice_numbers 'reuse pool' — INV/07/0001 was hard-deleted with no trace kept.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend and frontend verification passed: API-created QA invoices were deleted through DELETE /api/finance/invoices/{id}, remained in MongoDB with status='deleted' and deletion metadata, were excluded from default invoice lists, and appeared only when status=deleted/Deleted filter was selected. No MOCKED APIs used.
critical_code_review_comments: Code inspection confirmed GET /finance/invoices excludes status='deleted' by default and DELETE /finance/invoices/{id} uses update_one to set status='deleted' plus deleted_at/deleted_by/deletion_reason/previous_status instead of delete_one. Non-blocking: the DELETE endpoint docstring still says 'Permanently delete'/'Removes invoice from database', but runtime behavior is soft-delete.
seed_data_creation: Created QA test invoices INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0001 and INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0002 through the ad-hoc invoice API during verification; both were soft-deleted via the DELETE endpoint and remain in DB as status='deleted'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend evidence: /app/tests/test_invoice_soft_delete_flow.py passed for login, API create, DELETE 200, MongoDB retained document with status='deleted' and metadata, default GET excluded deleted rows, status=deleted returned the row, and draft/issued/paid/cancelled/voided/converted/approved/pending filters returned 200 with matching statuses. Frontend evidence: preview Finance > Invoices showed Deleted option, Deleted filter displayed soft-deleted QA invoices, and All Invoices hid them after switching back.
rca_of_the_issue: Original RCA was destructive deletion via db.invoices.delete_one causing invoice-number audit gaps. Verified mitigation is soft-delete persistence with status='deleted' plus deletion metadata and explicit Deleted filter visibility. Note: the app has /api/finance/invoices/adhoc for the safe test invoice creation flow; no generic POST /api/finance/invoices route was present in the inspected route file.
